name: Fan Speed Monitor
description: Live fan speed monitor for laptops (Dell, ThinkPad, ASUS, and generic Linux hwmon).

poll_interval_ms.label: Poll Interval (ms)
poll_interval_ms.description: Interval between sensor queries in milliseconds.

show_label.label: Show Fan Speed Text
show_label.description: Show the fan speed numbers in the bar next to the icon.

show_unit.label: Show RPM Unit
show_unit.description: Append 'RPM' to the fan speed display in the bar.

colorize_by_speed.label: Colorize by Speed
colorize_by_speed.description: Change the icon color based on fan speed (idle, normal, high load).

high_rpm_threshold.label: High RPM Alert Threshold
high_rpm_threshold.description: RPM level at which the fan icon displays a warning color.
